senses.gloss: लवणा lavaṇā, f. N. of a river.

लावण lāvaṇa, a. salt, salted: -ka, N. of a 🞄locality;
 -saindhava, a. (ī) situated on the 🞄salt sea.

लवन lav-ana, n. cutting (of corn), reaping, 🞄mowing;
 cutting instrument, sickle, scythe: 🞄-kartṛ, m. reaper, mower.
लवन्य lavanya, m. a class of men.
लवराज lava-rāja, m. N. of a Brāhman.
लवली lavalī, f. kind of creeper.
लवशस् lava-śas, ad. in small pieces.

लावणिक lāvaṇ-ika, a. (ī) dealing in salt;
 🞄charming, lovely.
लावम् lāv-am, abs. w. √ lū, cut off like (—˚).

लावाणक lāvāṇa-ka, m. N. of a district near 🞄Magadha;
 N. of the third Lambaka of the 🞄Kathāsaritsāgara.
